record.measurement_method: classical MD (MetalWalls, DIPPIM force field) with Nernst-Einstein conversion and Bayesian Arrhenius extrapolation
record.notes: This is the median of the posterior-predicted room-temperature conductivity obtained by extrapolating the Arrhenius fit to MD data at 500-800 K; it is not a measured value. The 300 K value is an extrapolation, and the 95% interval is 75.8 +30.6 -22.5. The unit 'mScm' is as written in the text (the paper's figures use mS cm-1). Activation energy 0.123 ± 0.016 eV is from the same LLZO Arrhenius fit (Section III), reported in text with PDF-garbled symbols. Conductivity kind is not specified (MD-derived via Nernst-Einstein with Haven ratio 1.5).
